run_cocofy_lvis: run the script to convert LVIS annotations to COCO-compatible format for train and val splits
cocofy_lvis_function: filter LVIS instance segmentation annotations to keep only COCO categories and rewrite category IDs
convert_lvis_to_coco: convert an LVIS JSON annotation file to COCOfied format with COCO category IDs via synset mapping
review_COCO_SYNSET_CATEGORIES: review the list of 90 COCO synset to category ID mappings used for LVIS filtering
summarize_cocofy_lvis: summarize how cocofy_lvis filters annotations, remaps category IDs, and updates image-level category lists
